answer_1.quote: We evaluate PlugD on a fact verification dataset, FEVER, four question answering datasets, including Natural Questions (NQ), HotpotQA, TriviaQA, ELI5, a dialogue generation dataset, Wizard of Wikipedia (WoW), and two slot filling datasets, Zero Shot RE (zsRE)...
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers for question answering, verifies facts, generates dialogue responses, and fills slots based on document knowledge.

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we adopt accuracy for the fact verification task (FEVER) and slot filling tasks (zsRE, T-REx); exact match (EM) and F1 score for the extractive question answering tasks (NQ, HotpotQA, TriviaQA); ROUGE-L (RL) for the long abstractive question answering tasks (ELI5); F1 score for the dialogue generation task (WoW).
